zh: 卡内基梅隆大学（Carnegie Mellon University，简称CMU）成立于1900年，位于美国宾夕法尼亚州匹兹堡市，是世界顶尖的私立研究型大学。学校在计算机科学、人工智能、机器人、戏剧、艺术管理等领域位居世界领先地位，其校训“我的心在工作”（My Heart is in the Work）体现了务实创新的精神。CMU培养了大量计算机科学和艺术领域的杰出人才，对现代科技和文化发展产生了深远影响。
en: Carnegie Mellon University (CMU), founded in 1900, is a world-leading private research university located in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania. It excels in computer science, artificial intelligence, robotics, drama, arts management, and more. Its motto 'My Heart is in the Work' reflects a pragmatic and innovative spirit. CMU has produced outstanding talents in computer science and the arts, profoundly impacting modern technology and culture.
